message.content: So we are mounting evidence refuting every claim on the internet?

content.text: No. The evidence pushes back on one claim: that Raw out-damages Lightning, Dark or Magic on the Black Dragon Greataxe against other players. Every piece of it depends on a single input, the damage formula we read from the EXE. Under that formula, defense subtracts a flat amount from physical damage but only a percentage from elemental damage, so splitting the damage is not penalised twice. The margins, the 1.2% of builds with lightning defense above 366, and the rejected explanations (scaling, buffs, PvE intent) all use that formula, so they don't test it. They only show that the formula disagrees with players. PvE is unrefuted, because the enemy damage path hasn't been read, and it's the case most guides are written for. Nothing has been checked against in-game numbers either. The one test that can show our formula is wrong is reading the game's actual damage against a known defense: a Raw hit and a Lightning hit on the same armoured target. If those numbers don't match what the formula predicts, it's our 14 years of nothing against their 14 years of something.
